description: This file defines an actor class 'DiagnosticsFileLog' responsible for logging diagnostic events to a JSON Lines log file. It includes functionality for logging, file rotation, and directory management, as well as defining a 'Record' structure for log entries.

classes.name: DiagnosticsFileLog
classes.description: An actor class that handles logging diagnostic events to a file, including managing log rotation based on file size, and exposing methods to log events and clear logs.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: logDirectoryURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the directory where log files are stored.

methods.name: logFileURL
methods.description: Returns the full URL for the log file.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Records a log event with a category, event name, and optional fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the current log file and any rotated backup files.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a log record to the file, ensuring directory exists and performing rotation if needed.

methods.name: ensureDirectory
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a log record to the log file.

methods.name: rotateIfNeeded
methods.description: Rotates log files when the current log exceeds the maximum size.

methods.name: rotatedURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for a rotated log file given its index.
